description.fun: A robot Tyranitar with green armour and glowing, see-through panels in its body, rumoured to be what Tyranitar will look like a billion years from now. It's said to be cool-headed and highly intelligent, preferring to avoid unnecessary fights. Its design draws on mecha kaiju, and may nod to the mechanical Tyranitar in Pokéstar Studios' Big Monster films.
description.guide: A Rock and Electric-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Violet, said to be either a future relative of Tyranitar or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It is said to be calm and intelligent, avoiding needless fights.
description.tagline: A calm, clever robot Tyranitar from a billion years ahead, maybe
